issues.title: Missing Core Token Definitions
issues.why: The spec references 'src/index.css' and 'tailwind.config.ts' as the single source of truth for tokens, but the actual HSL values for the 40+ tokens are only partially listed in tables, not provided as a complete file or block.
issues.fix: Include the full content of the normative 'src/index.css' file containing all :root and .dark HSL triplets.

issues.title: Truncated Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: The AC file (97-acceptance-criteria.md) is truncated at AC-003 due to context limits, leaving 31 of 34 criteria (AC-004 to AC-034) undefined for the coder.
issues.fix: Provide the remaining 31 GWT acceptance criteria in a follow-up or condensed block.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency/Flash Handling
issues.why: The 'Theme Transition' section mentions a 0.3s transition but doesn't specify how to prevent 'Flash of Unstyled Content' (FOUC) or 'Flash of Incorrect Theme' during SSR/Hydration.
issues.fix: Add a requirement for an inline blocking script in the HTML head to apply the '.dark' class before the first paint.
